findings.observation: Lane e2e-smoke declared PR-blocking in test_matrix.yaml, but GitHub required context is only pr-gate-complete and neither github_required_checks.yaml nor pr-required.yml include e2e-matrix-health.yml.
findings.method: Inspection of test_matrix.yaml, github_required_checks.yaml, pr-required.yml, e2e-matrix-health.yml, docs/00-project/governance/05-github-policy.md; grep for e2e-matrix-health in catalog/coordinator returned no matches.
findings.expected: Advertised PR-blocking e2e-smoke (matrix-smoke-blocking + chembl e2e_smoke) is a merge-required check via pr-gate-complete catalog, matching GitHub ruleset 13643213.
findings.actual: e2e-matrix-health.yml still runs on pull_request independently; catalog/coordinator omit it; required context is exactly pr-gate-complete. tests.yml control-plane-e2e (PubChem only) is a different lane.
findings.impact: Auto-merge and ruleset can land a PR with a failed advertised e2e-smoke (ChEMBL activity + pipeline matrix). Full-cycle regression for those paths is not merge-gated.
findings.remediation: Either add e2e-matrix-health/matrix-smoke-blocking as a pr-gate-complete owner (catalog + pr-required.yml reusable call or equivalent fail-closed need) or stop calling the lane PR-blocking in test_matrix.yaml.
findings.automation: Architecture test: catalog/coordinator must reference the declared e2e-smoke CI owner; keep tests/architecture/test_e2e_health_mode_policy.py.
findings.root_cause: e2e-smoke CI owner is an independent workflow while GitHub required context is only pr-gate-complete

evidence.observation: e2e-smoke description: PR-blocking; canonical CI owner e2e-matrix-health.yml job matrix-smoke-blocking
No e2e-matrix-health matches; aggregator pr-gate-complete; tests owner_jobs omit matrix-smoke-blocking
Ruleset 13643213 required context is exactly pr-gate-complete; allow_auto_merge true

findings.acceptance: Either add e2e-matrix-health/matrix-smoke-blocking as a pr-gate-complete owner (catalog + pr-required.yml reusable call or equivalent fail-closed need) or stop calling the lane PR-blocking in test_matrix.yaml.

findings.observation: Four architecture modules skip entirely or in part on Windows/WSL via mounted_worktree_skip_reason; local canonical Windows pytest cannot exercise those governance guards.
findings.method: Grep mounted_worktree_skip_reason under tests/; read _platform_skip_support.py and pytestmark skip sites.
findings.expected: Architecture merge-relevant guards run on the documented Windows local command, or skipif is inventoried with owner/expiry; CI remains the merge authority on ubuntu-latest.
findings.actual: Skip reason is filesystem performance on win/WSL. Files: test_public_facade_inventory.py, test_public_surface_importer_census_governance.py, test_domain_composite_config_importer_map.py, test_diagram_drift_and_embed_guards.py. CI Ubuntu still collects them.
findings.impact: Windows contributors get a false-local-green on those architecture surfaces; defects there are only caught in Linux CI.
findings.remediation: Keep CI Linux as merge truth; either bound the skip to measured timeouts with skipif in the reviewed census, or provide a Windows-safe subset so local architecture-fast-boundary is not silently thinner.
findings.automation: Extend tests/architecture/test_test_skip_inventory.py to census architecture skipif/pytestmark skip, or document Windows-excluded nodeids in test_matrix.
findings.root_cause: architecture modules apply pytest.mark.skip on Windows/WSL for filesystem performance without a Windows-equivalent local lane

evidence.observation: Returns skip reason on sys.platform startswith win and on WSL /proc/version microsoft
pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip(reason=_SKIP_REASON) when reason is not None

findings.acceptance: Keep CI Linux as merge truth; either bound the skip to measured timeouts with skipif in the reviewed census, or provide a Windows-safe subset so local architecture-fast-boundary is not silently thinner.
findings.rollback: revert catalog/workflow/docs change in the same changeset

findings.observation: Guard test_unit_and_architecture_forbid_unconditional_skip_marker only matches the decorator token @pytest.mark.skip(; pytestmark assignment/append and add_marker are invisible to it.
findings.method: Read _unconditional_skip_marker_paths; grep pytestmark skip under tests/architecture.
findings.expected: Unconditional skip census for unit/architecture covers decorator, pytestmark assignment, and add_marker forms, matching the skip-inventory AST walker used for contract/integration/e2e.
findings.actual: Scanner searches decorator substring. Architecture files use pytestmark assignment/append. Unit HTTP conftest uses item.add_marker(pytest.mark.skip) when local TCP bind fails.
findings.impact: New hidden skips can be added without failing the architecture forbid test; skip inventory still does not cover unit/architecture by design.
findings.remediation: Reuse _suppression_count_from_source / AST Call walker for unit+architecture skip census instead of a decorator substring check.
findings.root_cause: unconditional skip forbid uses decorator substring not AST Call census

evidence.observation: decorator substring gate: if @pytest.mark.skip( not in source: continue
pytest.mark.skip via add_marker when local TCP bind fails

findings.acceptance: Reuse _suppression_count_from_source / AST Call walker for unit+architecture skip census instead of a decorator substring check.

findings.remediation: Align gates.tests.owner_jobs (and canonical_checks if needed) with tests.yml tests-complete.needs plus coverage-verify producers.

findings.acceptance: Align gates.tests.owner_jobs (and canonical_checks if needed) with tests.yml tests-complete.needs plus coverage-verify producers.

findings.observation: test_matrix execution_defaults.direct_runner is only scripts/engineering/dev/run_pytest.sh; Windows canonical command is .venv-win python -m pytest / run_pytest.ps1.
findings.method: Read test_matrix execution_defaults; TEST_LANE_MENTAL_MODEL.md; scripts/engineering/dev/README.md; pyproject addopts.
findings.expected: Lane SSOT names both POSIX and Windows runners so local/CI commands stay comparable.
findings.actual: Lanes pin runner: run_pytest.sh. Windows path exists (run_pytest.ps1, .venv-win) but is not the matrix direct_runner. pytest addopts remain serial (no global xdist).
findings.impact: Low: Windows can still run pytest; matrix wrappers and CI are Linux. Risk is operator drift, not missing gates.
findings.remediation: Add windows_runner: scripts/engineering/dev/run_pytest.ps1 (and python -m pytest) to execution_defaults without changing lane pytest_args.
